q: Why did Data Center revenue change in 2025-Q4 vs 2025-Q3?
oracle: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' THEN revenue ELSE -revenue END) FROM sales WHERE segment='Data Center' AND period BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-12'

q: What drove the change in Gaming revenue from 2024 to 2025?
oracle: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period LIKE '2025-%' THEN revenue ELSE -revenue END) FROM sales WHERE segment='Gaming' AND period BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-12'

q: Explain the revenue bridge for Q2 2025 compared to Q1 2025
oracle: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' THEN revenue ELSE -revenue END) FROM sales WHERE period BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06'

q: Why did Automotive revenue grow in 2025-Q3?
oracle: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE segment='Automotive' AND period BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09'
